ios.desc:
Say your day. See every meal.

Breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks, in one recording. CaptureCal turns what you say into separate food and meal logs with calorie and macro estimates. Give a quick, one-minute recap of what you ate and let AI handle the entries.

LOG YOUR WHOLE DAY BY VOICE
Tap the microphone, describe your meals naturally, then stop recording. CaptureCal identifies the foods, creates individual entries and adds them to your selected day. Include portions, drinks and snacks in the same recording.

Try: "Two eggs and toast for breakfast, a chicken sandwich for lunch, an apple, and pasta with tomato sauce for dinner."

LOG YOUR WAY
• Photo: take a meal photo or choose one from your library. Add portion or ingredient details to help the estimate.
• Voice: describe one meal or your whole day in one go.
• Text: type what you ate in everyday language.
• Barcode: scan packaged foods and describe how much you ate.
• Repeat: add recent or favorite meals again in a tap.

SEE THE BIG PICTURE
Track calories, protein, carbs and fat, plus sugar, fiber and sodium. See daily totals against your goals, track water and weight, and view your history. Set calorie and macro targets for weight loss, maintenance or weight gain.

MAKE THE LOG FIT YOUR LIFE
Review and edit meal details. Move a meal to another day when you need to correct its date. Choose whether to receive meal reminders. With your permission, sync supported nutrition, water, weight and workout data with Apple Health.

MORE THAN A FOOD LOG
Log workouts and generate workout plans based on your goals, equipment and exercise history.

START WITH FREE LOGGING
CaptureCal includes free meal logging with daily limits. New accounts get a higher photo and voice allowance for the first three days. CaptureCal Premium removes daily limits on photo, voice and text meal logging. An account is required.

Spend less time entering food and more time getting on with your day.

Nutrition values and calorie targets are estimates, not medical advice. Review results and consult a qualified health professional before changing your diet or exercise plan. Recording and processing times vary.
